header.running_head: 3. Belief in the Events after Death...

blocks.tamil_translation: commanded, and I will return for the fourth time. Then I will praise Allah with the same words, and it will be said to me, “O Muhammad! Raise your head!” Speak, your words will be heard; ask, it will be given; intercede, it will be accepted.” I will say, “My Lord! Give me permission to bring out of the Fire even the one who said the noble Kalimah “La ilaha illallah’!” Allah will say, “By My honour! By My lofty rank! By My greatness! By My exaltedness! Whoever has said this Kalimah, I Myself will surely bring him out of the Fire.”

blocks.text: In the narration of Hazrat Abu Sa'id Khudri (RA) it is mentioned as follows: “In answer to the fourth plea of the Prophet ﷺ, Allah will say, “The angels have interceded, the Prophets have interceded, and the believers have interceded. Now none remains except Arhamur-Rahimin (the Most Merciful of those who show mercy),” and then Allah will bring out of the Fire a handful of people from among those who never did any good deed before, and who will be (burnt) like charcoal in the Fire. Near the gate of Jannah a river called “the River of Life’ will be flowing, and Allah will put them into it. They will come out of it (at once, completely renewed); just as a seed sprouts in the debris of a flood (from the mixing of water and soil), they will sprout fresh and green and come out.
